guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows a massive +1118% spike in productcatalogservice_mem (z=+223.66) alongside a +475% CPU increase, indicating severe memory pressure or a leak. Trace data confirms that all top latency/availability failures route through productcatalogservice, directly correlating the memory exhaustion with the observed service degradation.

proposed_fix.description: Deploy a hotfix to address the memory leak in productcatalogservice and temporarily increase its memory allocation to prevent OOM kills.
